docs.help:
Start a Game

Choose Play vs AI, pass-and-play, or online play. Pass-and-play lets both sides move on the same device according to the current turn.

Basics

  1. Click or drag a piece to move.
  2. Selection highlights, legal targets, and capture hints can be configured in Settings.
  3. Pause stops the clocks; resume restarts the current side's clock.

Replays

Use the File menu to save, export, or load .xhgame files. The replay window supports jumping, stepping, autoplay, and the local replay library.

Rule Notes

  • The Archer uses the weaker star-track move by default; the enhanced option expands it.
  • Every diagonal segment must pass the pincer check, including Advisor and Elephant moves.
  • Pawns can march quickly before entering enemy territory, stopping at the boundary.

Shortcuts

Ctrl+N New, Ctrl+O Load, Ctrl+S Export, Ctrl+Z Undo, Ctrl+R Replay, F11 Fullscreen.

Feedback

GitHub Issues · 2741526119@qq.com

docs.about:
Version 1.7.0

Xionghan Chess is a Chinese chess variant on a 13 × 13 expanded board, blending Xiongnu and Eastern Han themes with configurable special pieces and rules.

This Version

  • Supports Windows, Web, and Android.
  • Shares the Python rules, AI, online protocol, and .xhgame replay format.
  • Supports AI, pass-and-play, online rooms, pauseable clocks, replays, chat, and replay management.

Development

Developer: Jin Zhongyuan
Project: github.com/Jinny168/xionghan-chess
Email: 2741526119@qq.com

Thanks to the original project work, assets, menu design, player feedback, and the open-source tools and audio resources used here.

desktop.handicap_note: Both sides must start with the same number of pieces; leaders are mandatory.
desktop.equal_setup: Both sides must start with the same number of pieces
desktop.atlas_hint: Pick a piece on the left; switch styles instantly at the top right.
desktop.atlas_demo_pending: Demo board coming up: pick a preset position to see where this piece can move and capture.
desktop.atlas_glyph_fallback: No art in this style — showing a same-style glyph
desktop.atlas_glyph_family_note: Glyph family follows the style (traditional: serif / modern, cartoon: sans); ink matches neighbouring pieces closely.
desktop.atlas_preset_free_note: A small position built around the selected piece: green dots are moves, red crosses are captures. Click a square to play one move.
desktop.atlas_preset_clamp_note: The Archer moves diagonally, but both flanking squares at the start are occupied, so this segment is pinched — even a distant enemy on the same diagonal cannot be taken.
desktop.atlas_preset_three_note: Two allied pawns sandwich an enemy on a line: with the toggle on, the enemy is removed after the move (off by default).
desktop.atlas_preset_facing_note: Both kings share a file with nothing between: facing counts as check, so any move that leaves them facing is illegal.
desktop.atlas_switch_title: Switches for this piece (saved to config)
desktop.atlas_switch_none: This piece has no adjustable rule.
desktop.atlas_rule_changed: Rule updated — restart the game to apply it.
desktop.atlas_rule_saved: Saved; takes effect after you restart the game.
